versions.changelog:
- Added new sub-skills: `neta-character` for character creation/management and `neta-elementum` for visual style/concept management.
- Updated installation instructions and capability map to include these new sub-skills.
- Expanded the task classification guide and use cases, reflecting the broader set of Neta capabilities.
- Updated the migration table to map legacy features to the newly added sub-skills.
- Improved formatting and examples for clarity and consistency.

Summary: The neta skill has transitioned from a monolithic “all-in-one” interface to an overview/routing role, with concrete features migrated to specialized sub-skills.

- Split the previous kitchen-sink skill into four focused sub-skills: neta-space, neta-creative, neta-community, and neta-suggest.
- SKILL.md rewritten to serve as a capability map and migration guide, helping users select the right sub-skill for their needs.
- Removed all detailed command usage and in-depth reference guides from this skill.
- Deleted now-obsolete documentation files covering individual features (image generation, space browsing, etc.).
- Added clear migration instructions for users referencing old documentation.

- Major cleanup: removed 139 files, streamlining the skill codebase.
- Added a new reference: `social-interactive.md` for community interaction features.
- Updated documentation to include a new community interaction command (`like_collection`) and its usage.
- Expanded documentation tables to cover the new community/social interaction guide.
- Removed legacy files and commands for a simplified structure.

neta 1.0.0 — First release

- Introduces skill for interacting with the Neta API, supporting image, video, and song generation, as well as character and tag search.
- Provides CLI commands for exploring spaces, managing tags, querying characters, and recommending community and interactive content.
- Includes references and best practice guidelines to assist users in AI-assisted content creation and research.
